job.title: Product Owner - Data
job.description:
Data Product Owner (SaaS)

Location: Leeds (Hybrid: 2–3 days per week in-office)

Salary: Up to £60,000 basic

Reporting to: Head of Data

 

A global SaaS innovator is looking for a commercially minded, value-driven Data Product Owner to take charge of a complex product roadmap and transform a massive backlog into high-impact deliverables.

 

Working closely with global clients and technical data squads, you will bridge the gap between deep technical capability and clear commercial return.

 

The Mission

Your focus is straightforward: cut through the noise, ruthlessly prioritize, and deliver immediate and long-term value. You won’t just manage tickets. you will shape the product vision, validate feature requests directly with clients, and ensure the engineering team builds the right solutions at pace.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Value-Driven Prioritization: Triage, refine, and structure a massive backlog, mapping every feature directly to measurable business and client value.
  • Roadmap Ownership: Collaborate directly with the Head of Data and executive stakeholders to define, adapt, and execute a transparent product roadmap.
  • Client & Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary technical voice for external enterprise clients, translating complex requirements into actionable user stories and clear release plans.
  • Agile Execution: Lead sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, and retrospectives within a dynamic, fast-paced data and software engineering environment.
  • Metric Definition: Define and track product success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) to validate feature adoption and ROI post-launch.

 

What You Bring

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager within a SaaS, Data, or Digital platform environment.
  • Exceptional prioritization framework experience (e.g., WSJF, MoSCoW, RICE) with a track record of decluttering legacy backlogs.
  • Strong client-facing skills with the ability to confidently push back, manage expectations, and discover genuine client needs.
  • Fluency across technical ecosystems (Engineering, Analytics, or AI-driven platforms) to converse effortlessly with Engineers.
  • Comfort operating in an evolving, high-tempo Agile environment where priorities can shift quickly.

 

The Setup

  • Location: Modern Leeds hub with collaborative spaces (hybrid model: 2–3 days on-site, remainder remote).
  • Leadership: High visibility, reporting directly into the Head of Data with direct input on strategic product architecture.

 

To apply or discuss the role in confidence, submit your CV or reach out directly for a brief discovery call.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and delivering the company's technology strategy, ensuring its systems, infrastructure, applications and data capabilities support both current operations and future expansion plans.
Working closely with the Executive Team and Board, you will have significant influence over business strategy while leading the implementation of technology initiatives that enhance performance, scalability and customer value.

  • Deliver technology roadmaps through a combination of internal resources and external partners.

About You

You will likely bring experience across many of the following areas:

  • Azure Cloud architecture and infrastructure.
  • Networking and enterprise systems.
  • Identity and access management.
  • ERP and CRM platforms.
  • AI implementation and automation technologies.
  • Disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

  • Experience managing significant IT budgets and investment programmes.
  • Exposure to mergers, acquisitions and post-acquisition integration.
  • Experience within retail technology, SaaS, payments, loyalty, fintech or related technology-driven sectors.
Why Join?
This is an opportunity to join a business where technology sits at the heart of its growth strategy. You'll work alongside a highly engaged leadership team, influence company-wide decision making and play a central role in shaping the next stage of the organisation's evolution.
The environment rewards initiative, innovation and accountability, offering significant scope to make a visible impact and leave a lasting legacy.

  • Competitive salary of £100,000 - £130,000
  • Company bonus scheme
  • Hybrid working
  • Pension scheme
  • Life assurance
  • Health and wellbeing benefits
  • 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Ongoing learning and development support
  • Career progression opportunities
  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial culture
Apply
If you're an ambitious technology leader looking for an opportunity to influence strategy, drive innovation and help scale a growing technology-led business, we'd be delighted to speak with you.
For a confidential discussion or to apply, please get in touch.

job.title: Solutions Architect
job.description:
Solution Architect | Enterprise FMCG & Supply Chain Systems

Location: Bristol (Hybrid – 2 days/week in-office)

Contract Type: 1–2 Year Fixed-Term Contract (FTC) (Day-rate contract potentially considered)

 

The Opportunity

We are headhunting on behalf of a beloved household UK brand based near Bristol, known for its commitment to quality, sustainability, and innovation.

They are embarking on a major technology modernization journey across their enterprise landscape and need a hands-on, broad-scope Solution Architect to shape and drive the design. You won’t be locked into a single niche here, this is a wide-reaching role spanning enterprise systems, complex data integrations, operational processes, and supply chain logistics.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Enterprise Architecture: Lead the design and delivery of scalable tech solutions across core operational business areas (ERP, Supply Chain, Logistics, Data).
  • Bridge Tech & Business: Translate complex business requirements from supply chain and manufacturing teams into resilient architectural blueprints.
  • Data & Integration Management: Architect seamless data pipelines and integration strategies to connect legacy infrastructure with modern cloud/SaaS platforms.
  • Stakeholder Ownership: Work closely with C-suite stakeholders, operational leaders, and 3rd-party vendors to align technology with strategic business goals.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven Track Record: Solid experience as a Solution Architect within FMCG, Manufacturing, Logistics, or Supply Chain environments.
  • Broad Architectural Scope: Comfortable working across applications, data integration, security, and infrastructure (not just a pure software or pure cloud architect).
  • Enterprise Systems & Integration: Experience integrating complex ecosystems (ERP, WMS, modern data stacks, middleware/APIs).
  • Stakeholder Impact: Pragmatic, persuasive, and able to demystify technical decisions for non-technical business leaders.

 

Working Pattern & Terms

  • Hybrid Model: 2 days/week on-site near Bristol for critical collaboration; 3 days/week remote.
  • Engagement: Offered primarily as a 1 to 2-year Fixed-Term Contract, providing medium-term stability on high-impact projects. (Flexible day-rate contract options may be explored for the right candidate).

 

If you're a broad-minded architect looking to leave a lasting mark on a major British brand's supply chain technology, apply today or reach out directly for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Head of Data Management
job.description:
The Company

Our client is a global organisation investing heavily in its data and technology foundations following a strong period of M&A growth. With a growing focus on consistency, quality, and alignment across regions, data has become a strategic priority underpinning commercial performance, automation, and operational improvement.

 

This is a pivotal moment in the organisation’s data journey, with new leadership, frameworks actively being embedded, and a genuine openness to change.

 

Why join our client?

  • Senior mandate with real influence across a global organisation
  • Executive sponsorship for data and governance transformation
  • Opportunity to shape a new enterprise-wide data governance framework
  • Visible, business-facing role demonstrating tangible value from data
  • Strong salary package and long-term career progression

 

The Role

As Head of Data Governance, you will be responsible for bringing coherence, consistency, and value to the organisation’s data landscape. Working closely with senior leaders across, Operations, IT, InfoSec, and Finance, you’ll define and embed the data governance framework, inclusive of roles responsibilities and then evangelise the use of data across the organisation so that you genuinely enable the business to use and work with data.

 

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and embed an enterprise-wide data governance framework across global regions
  • Lead the identification and definition of data, and continue to build the business glossary, data dictionary and data catalogue.
  • Establish clear datasets, ownership models, and governance operating processes so data is well controlled, managed and the stakeholder's trust it.
  • Develop data quality dashboards by region to demonstrate measurable improvement and value
  • Act as an internal advocate for data through education and change leadership

 

Your Experience

In Summary, we are looking for a senior data professional who can combine structure with pragmatism and influence change in complex environments.

 

You will bring:

  • Proven experience leading data governance or data management initiatives at enterprise scale
  • Strong understanding of data quality, metadata, stewardship, and governance frameworks
  • Experience operating within fragmented and disparate data and processes with the passion and stamina to deliver change and improve ways of working and use of data in this company.
  • A pragmatic, educational approach to governance with low resistance and high adoption

job.title: Principal Software Engineer (Data Platforms)

The Company

Our client is a rapidly scaling technology business where data sits at the heart of everything they build. They're investing heavily in a brand-new Data Platforms function responsible for building the infrastructure that powers analytics, AI and next-generation software products.

Operating at significant scale, they process and manage hundreds of terabytes of data today, with the platform growing towards petabyte scale. This is an opportunity to solve genuinely difficult engineering problems where performance, reliability and scalability are critical.

Why this role stands out:

  • Join as a founding engineer within a brand-new Data Platforms team
  • Build highly scalable systems capable of supporting 100TB–1PB of data
  • Shape the architecture, tooling and engineering culture from day one
  • Work on complex distributed systems and platform engineering challenges
  • Hybrid working from Oxford with excellent benefits and long-term progression

This is a builder's role through and through.

As Principal Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing and building the core platforms that enable engineers, analysts and product teams to work with massive volumes of data efficiently and reliably. You'll remain hands-on while providing technical leadership, helping define engineering standards, mentoring a growing team and influencing the long-term technical direction of the platform.

If you enjoy solving problems around scale, performance and distributed systems, this is the kind of environment where you'll thrive.

What You'll Be Building

  • Cloud-native platforms designed to process and serve data at massive scale
  • High-performance backend systems that prioritise reliability and availability
  • Internal tooling that enables engineering teams to move faster and build with confidence
  • Modern engineering practices centred around automation, testing and continuous delivery
  • A high-performing engineering culture built on collaboration, ownership and technical excellence
  • The foundations for future AI, analytics and large-scale data capabilities

Your Experience

We're looking for an experienced software engineer who enjoys building platforms from first principles and has a passion for solving complex engineering challenges.

Essential Experience

  • 8 + years building large-scale backend software systems
  • Strong commercial experience with Python
  • Experience leading and mentoring software engineering teams
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and scalable platform architecture
  • Passion for software quality, automation and engineering best practices
  • Track record of delivering complex systems from concept through to production

Nice to Have

  • Experience building modern data or developer platforms
  • Exposure to distributed compute, scheduling, streaming or storage technologies
  • Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, ideally AWS
  • Interest in modern AI-assisted software development practices

 

Why Join?

  • Competitive salary, annual bonus and comprehensive benefits package
  • Opportunity to shape a brand-new platform engineering function
  • Work on engineering challenges involving hundreds of terabytes to petabytes of data
  • Collaborative, low-ego engineering culture with genuine technical ownership
  • Hybrid working model based in Oxford with flexibility
  • Clear opportunity to influence architecture, engineering standards and long-term platform strategy

 

Please click apply if you feel you'd be a good fit.

job.description:
AI & MLOps Engineer

UK Remote | Generative AI |  Cloud-Native ML Systems

 

We are working in partnership with a global, technology-driven insights organisation to hire an AI & MLOps Engineer to join a cutting-edge Synthetic Data team.

 

This is a high-impact opportunity to work at the forefront of generative AI and machine learning platforms, helping turn advanced research into scalable, production-grade systems used across a global business.

 

The Opportunity

You’ll join a multidisciplinary team building a next-generation platform focused on:

  • Synthetic data generation at scale
  • AI-powered data augmentation tools
  • “Digital twin” models powered by LLMs
  • Privacy-first, enterprise-grade ML infrastructure

 

The team blends data science, software engineering, and research, with strong links to leading academic institutions—ensuring the work is both scientifically rigorous and commercially impactful.

 

The Role

As an AI & MLOps Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in bridging research and production, ensuring complex models are deployed in a reliable, scalable and cost-efficient way.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Productionising cutting-edge AI models (LLMs, diffusion models, synthetic data generators)
  • Designing and maintaining scalable ML pipelines and workflows
  • Building fault-tolerant orchestration layers for long-running, compute-heavy jobs
  • Implementing CI/CD pipelines for machine learning, including model testing and versioning
  • Driving observability and monitoring, including model performance, data drift, and system health
  • Optimising cloud infrastructure and compute usage (GPU/CPU, caching, scaling strategies)
  • Developing robust data architectures and asynchronous processing systems

 

You’ll work closely with applied ML researchers, acting as the key link that ensures innovation is translated into real-world, production-ready solutions.

 

Technology Environment

You’ll be working across a modern AI/ML stack including:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, PyTorch
  • MLOps & Platforms: Kubeflow, Vertex AI, Kubernetes, Docker
  • Backend Systems: FastAPI, async job queues (Celery/RabbitMQ)
  • Data & Storage: GCP, BigQuery, Parquet/Arrow, vector databases
  • LLM Tooling: RAG architectures, PEFT/LoRA fine-tuning

 

What We’re Looking For

MLOps & Engineering Expertise

  • Strong experience building and managing complex ML pipelines (DAGs)
  • Proven ability to deploy generative AI models into production
  • Hands-on with CI/CD for ML, model registries, and reproducibility

 

Data & Systems Engineering

  • Experience designing high-throughput data pipelines across structured and unstructured data
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous systems and APIs
  • Expertise in data validation and schema enforcement

 

AI/ML Knowledge

  • Solid Python and PyTorch skills
  • Familiarity with LLMs, diffusion models, or similar architectures
  • Experience with model monitoring, evaluation, and performance optimisation

 

Why Apply?

  • Work on cutting-edge generative AI use cases with real-world impact
  • Be part of a high-performing, research-driven engineering team
  • Shape how advanced ML systems are deployed at global scale
  • Gain exposure to complex challenges across AI, data, and platform engineering

 

If you’re passionate about building robust ML systems and want to work at the bleeding edge of AI innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

 

? Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation.
